source: Direct owner authorization quoted by Master in this QA conversation
owner_exact_question: 远端 CI 的未改动 1.3.1 基线出现 SIGINT/Spool 和超时失败。是否允许把这些既有 CI 稳定性问题纳入独立排查，必要时另作修复提交？保持全部断言，不推受保护分支、不合并或发布。
owner_exact_answer: 允许独立排查与必要修复（推荐）
authorized_exception: Bounded CI-only diagnostics and failure-capture retention, with separate deterministic deadline regression tests, may change the reviewed validation workflow. No Helm changes, runtime changes, production-budget changes, existing-assertion loosening, protected pushes, merges or publication are authorized.
claim_limit: This authorization is not a PASS, a G10 waiver, or a classification of the original failures as runner-only. Exact new-head diffs and fresh independent evidence remain required.
